summaries.summary: iOS Smart Printers page class implementing printer selection, verification, and navigation flows. Inherits from SmartFlow base class and provides methods for interacting with printer list, adding printers, and verifying various printer-related screens. Uses Selenium WebDriver for mobile automation with explicit waits and logging for test execution tracking.
summaries.test_automation_patterns: Page Object Model (POM) pattern with flow-based architecture, explicit waits using wait_for_object, dual selection strategy (index/name), conditional verification based on UI state, pytest integration for assertions, comprehensive logging for debugging, exception handling for TimeoutException and NoSuchElementException
